tools.name: list_tours
tools.description: List By Earth and Ocean tours in Noosa (kayak tours on the Noosa Everglades with stingrays, guided and self guided e-bike and mountain bike tours, fat bike beach rides). Returns each tour key, description, page and its session times.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Live places and prices for one tour on one date, straight from the booking system. Returns each session that can be booked, places left, total price for the group, the guest types it takes, and a booking link the customer can open to book themselves.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: List Bike On bike rentals in Noosa (e-bike cruisers, fat tyre e-bikes, mountain and e-mountain bikes, road and gravel bikes, kids and family bikes). Each bike shows its sizes with the rider height each size suits. Delivery areas and minimums are included.

tools.name: check_rental_availability
tools.description: Live availability and price for Bike On rental bikes over a date range, by size item_id, plus the delivery charge if a suburb is given. Each size suits a range of rider heights.

tools.name: get_booking_form
tools.description: The customer details needed to book a tour session or a rental (they vary by product), the booking terms the customer agrees to when booking, and the total price.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book a tour session or Bike On rental for the customer. The booking is made unpaid and holds the places for 30 minutes; the customer must pay with the payment link returned, on our secure booking page (no card details are ever taken here).
